upstream_restoration_trials.selection_reason: No tested upstream restoration configuration visibly resolves the attack-entry mottled/soft shading and broad dark facial/hair strokes while preserving the requested artwork. Do not promote sub-DN restoration changes as the requested improvement.
diagnosis: Current lossless PNG itself has softer broader hair/face contours and more painterly surface treatment than current Idle; this is not solely GIF encoding or transparent fringe.

Standard strong and tailored no-dither presets change some edge RGB and tiny interior details, but head/skin/coat visual cleanliness barely improves. Rejection is based on normal-alpha visual comparisons and fixed ROI metrics, not a single maximum pixel.
Even surface6/grime3/mottle2/sparkle2 produced only0.20/0.29/0.53DN mean changes in the neutral front/side/back opaque hair ROI; its residual noise diagnostic did not decrease.
Cel-fill declines these sprites (illustration_context=false) in whole-sheet, full-cell, and alpha-bbox-crop contexts. Its internal guard was not bypassed.
No rescaling, silhouette edits, face narrowing, palette remap, generative redraw, sharpening or custom blur was applied.
